step.cmd: Identify to the end-user the columns or cells that are modifiable by highlighting them in a different color.

You can delete the text in brackets. This does not remove the fields because those are in the map. This just makes the presentation more pleasing. Make sure to place your cursor in the cell and use the Delete key. Do not use row delete!

result.p: After you follow all the procedures in this section, a new App with the name Opportunities by Account has been created.
